resources.title: Pipeline Chain-Walking Diagnostic Checklist
resources.description: Lesson 56's four-step diagnostic sequence (Pipe → Stream → Task → Table) as a real, reusable checklist — the exact SQL for each link, what a healthy result looks like at each step, and what each specific failure signature (stuck pendingFileCount, an empty Stream, a SKIPPED vs. FAILED Task) actually points to. Walk it in order on any "the load didn't run" ticket instead of guessing which piece broke.

resources.title: Query Performance Decision Guide
resources.description: A decision tree from Chapter 10: how to read Query Profile's bytes-scanned-vs-returned signal, when a pruning failure means a clustering key (not a bigger warehouse), and when to scale up versus scale out a warehouse. Pairs every symptom with the specific lesson's fix instead of reaching for "just use a bigger warehouse" as a default.

resources.title: Resource Monitor + Statement Timeout Template
resources.description: A fill-in-the-blanks CREATE RESOURCE MONITOR statement with the layered 75/100/110 percent NOTIFY/SUSPEND/SUSPEND_IMMEDIATE pattern from Lesson 48, plus the matching STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_IN_SECONDS command — the two-layer safety net (a monthly budget and a per-query leash) ready to attach to a real warehouse.

resources.title: Data Project Review Rubric
resources.description: A five-dimension rubric (correctness, testing, documentation, performance awareness, maintainability) for reviewing your finished capstone — or any Snowflake project — against a real professional standard. Shared across the Analytics Engineer path's courses.
